opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK university or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two co-applicants covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven 'blue skies' research at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust. Awards up to £200,000 for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; prior public engagement experience expected. Previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with humanities and social sciences research, delivered in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum (GLAM) or a performing arts organisation. Awards up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation and visa costs; seed funding available for collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the broad theme of 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany. Includes seed funding for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Three-year award under FEC regime; Academy funds 80% of salary, directly allocated and indirect costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens, EEA nationals, anyone with a UK doctorate, or those demonstrating strong prior association with the UK academic community. Must not have been appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening their research and teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO, intending to pursue original independent research.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages), supporting innovative research methods via skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards up to £10,000 for 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting at least the award duration, postdoctoral or above, spending at least 20% time on the award. Overseas co-applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research programme on the theme of 'Mobilities', led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences, with collaboration across disciplines and international partners. Awards up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling UK-based SHAPE researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in policy sectors by embedding themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, producing policy-relevant analysis. Up to two one-year fellowships of up to £150,000.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, support to make an application). Rolling deadline, reviewed monthly.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom, with approval of employing institution; independent scholars eligible. Co-applicants may be from anywhere but Principal Applicant must be UK-resident.
opportunities.summary: The Academy's most popular scheme, providing awards up to £10,000 tenable for up to 24 months to cover expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences. Funded with DSIT, Leverhulme Trust and Wellcome Trust.
